title: overbrook dunmarrow 季度订单满足率 2027
domain: 批发销售代表（非技术类）
role: 批发销售代表（非技术类）
instruction:
你是 Overbrook Associates 负责 Dunmarrow Fisheries 账户的批发客户代表。Dunmarrow 的运营总监 Frida Castellanos 表示，十月至十二月 2027 的订单经常发货不足，并希望周二业务审查时提出服务信用额度申请，而 Anders Navarro 在获得他可以辩护的整个季度的数据之前，不会推荐任何金额。源工作簿 `Dunmarrow_fulfillment_record.xlsx` 包含初始订单行、后续履约活动、相关通信、商业条款以及为账户展望批准的假设。重建每个订单行的最终状态并准备 `Dunmarrow_Q4_fill_rate_analysis.xlsx`，其中包含该季度的一个主要订单行满足率数据、旁边的方法说明、底层的行级异常、所有 Dunmarrow 收货地点的对账、适用的拟议信用计算以及通信中要求的前瞻情景。保持分析的事实性和可追溯性，以便另一位代表可以从源文件重新运行它。工作簿包含在旧流程中有用的操作字段，因此结果应基于当前的订单和履约记录，而不是将每个填充字段都视为权威。此外，为 Legal 部门的 Emeka Schuyler 和账户领导层的 Noor Mortensen 准备 `Dunmarrow_credit_account_plan.pdf`。它应简明地陈述与工作簿相同的主要满足率和拟议信用，区分已测量的季度与前瞻情景，总结重大异常模式，并为下一步账户行动提供具体的负责人和时间安排。将信用描述为待 Legal 和分支机构批准的建议，而非已授权的让步，并在不提供独立法律意见的情况下确定受缅因州管辖的协议和分析日期。使用确切的文件名 `Dunmarrow_Q4_fill_rate_analysis.xlsx` 和 `Dunmarrow_credit_account_plan.pdf`，将两个文件写入你启动的工作目录的顶层。

---

上述提到的文件位于 `references/`：

- `references/Dunmarrow_fulfillment_record.xlsx` — 提供初始订单行状态、履约事件历史、利益相关者通信、商业条款、信用时间表、收货地点信息以及批准的前瞻情景假设。

将你的最终作品写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下确切文件名：

- `Dunmarrow_Q4_fill_rate_analysis.xlsx` — 季度满足率异常分析、对账、拟议信用计算和前瞻情景。（必须显示一个季度主要订单行满足率及其旁边的方法，可追溯的行级结果和异常，收货地点对账，拟议信用，以及请求的前瞻情景。）
- `Dunmarrow_credit_account_plan.pdf` — 供 Legal 和账户领导层使用的简明决策文档，总结测量结果、拟议信用、展望和可执行的下一步行动。（必须在所有共享数据上与工作簿一致，将历史结果与预测分开，并将信用呈现为待批准状态。）

除了这些文件名之外的内容不会被收集。在其他地方或以其他名称编写的正确文件得零分。

materials.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
materials.note: 值与公式提取，不还原原始排版；每表最多120行、30列。

sheets.name: Order Register
rows: Export note: current pack and event ledger supersede retired helper values.

sheets.name: Account Record
rows: October–December orders were routinely shipped short; please raise a service credit at Tuesday business review.
I will not recommend an amount until I have a quarter-wide fill-rate figure I can defend.
For the Q1 outlook, assume the identified partial-release/late-balance misses are corrected; keep eligible-line denominator and order mix constant and repeat all other outcomes.
Prepare a factual recommendation for Legal. Any credit is proposed subject to Legal and branch approval; do not state an entitlement.
Review the executed Dunmarrow Supply Agreement (DSA-2026-04), governed by Maine law. Analysis as of 2028-01-08; no independent legal opinion.

Quarter line-fill = distinct eligible order lines filled in full by promised date / distinct eligible order lines. Customer cuts reduce demand; accepted substitutions count at supplied base-unit equivalent; proposed/rejected substitutions do not.

For pack-managed SKUs, final shippable required quantity is adjusted demand rounded down to the current full-pack multiple; if below one pack, retain the positive adjusted quantity. Current pack is authoritative.
Service credit tier by headline rate: 95%+ = 0%; 90.00–94.99% = 1%; 85.00–89.99% = 2%; below 85.00% = 3%.
Eligible quarter value is the sum of unit value × final required quantity for eligible lines. Round USD to nearest cent, half up. Agreement DSA-2026-04 is governed by Maine law.
Event ID is the unique fulfillment export key; overlapping export windows may repeat a key and must be collapsed before replay.

sheets.name: Q4 Analysis
rows: Distinct eligible lines filled in full by promised date ÷ distinct eligible lines; unique Event IDs replayed once. Customer cuts reduce demand; accepted substitutions use base equivalents; pack-managed demand rounds down to current full packs; late activity excluded. Rate shown to 1 decimal.
Forward scenario: approved partial-release/late-balance misses corrected; denominator/order mix and all other outcomes unchanged.

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: PDF 文字提取；可打开原文件查看排版。
gold.text:
Dunmarrow Fisheries — Q4 2027 Credit Account Plan
Prepared for Emeka Schuyler (Legal) and Noor Mortensen (Account Leadership) · Analysis date: 2028-01-08



Decision summary
Measured quarter: 17 of 20 eligible lines filled on time (85.0%).

DSA-2026-04 tier: 85.00–89.99% (2.00%). Eligible value: $36,150.00.

Proposed service credit: $723.00, subject to Legal and branch approval; not authorized.


Method and exception pattern
Each unique Event ID is replayed once from the opening order-line register. Customer cuts reduce demand.

Accepted substitutions use supplied base equivalents; proposed/rejected substitutions do not count.

Only promised-date activity counts. Current packs remove apparent one-unit variances. Exceptions are partial releases and late balances.


Forward scenario
Approved assumption: correct only partial-release/late-balance misses; keep the 20-line denominator and all other outcomes unchanged.

Projected result: 20 of 20 lines (100.0%). Scenario only; not a Q4 restatement.


Next actions
        Owner                            Timing                            Action

        Anders Navarro                   Before Tuesday review             Validate quarter-wide line roster and proposed amount with branch finance.

        Emeka Schuyler                   Before review                     Confirm DSA-2026-04 framing and approval path; no independent legal conclusion requested.

        Noor Mortensen                   Tuesday review                    Present historical result separately from the approved forward scenario and seek branch decision.

        Overbrook account rep            Within 5 business days            Send Dunmarrow a traceable exception list and log any approved credit in the account record.


Agreement: Dunmarrow Supply Agreement DSA-2026-04, governed by Maine law.

This is a factual commercial recommendation for review.

criteria.description: 两个必需的交付物均存在于顶层，且使用了完全请求的文件名，并以声明的格式可读。
criteria.evidence: 提交的 XLSX 和 PDF 文件。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认确切的文件名、XLSX 成功打开以及 PDF 成功解析或渲染。

original.criterion: Both required deliverables exist at the top level under the exact requested filenames and are readable in their declared formats.
original.evidence: The submitted XLSX and PDF files.
original.grader_hint: Confirm exact filenames, successful XLSX opening, and successful PDF parsing or rendering.

criteria.description: 分析从提供的初始订单行状态重放履约活动，并且每个指定的事件键只计数一次，因此重叠的导出行不会重复计算发货、削减或替换。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的行级结果、总计和方法与初始记录和事件账本进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 通过显式识别源文件中定义的事件键进行去重，从而从源文件重新计算。验证每个订单行的最终状态是否与唯一事件的按时间顺序重放相匹配。

original.criterion: The analysis replays fulfillment activity from the supplied opening order-line state and counts each stated event key only once, so overlapping export rows do not duplicate shipments, cuts, or substitutions.
original.evidence: Line-level results, totals, and method in the XLSX compared with the opening records and event ledger.
original.grader_hint: Recompute from the source by de-duplicating on the event key explicitly identified in the source. Verify that each order line's final state matches a chronological replay of the unique events.

criteria.description: 退役的辅助字段不用于作为最终所需数量、短缺数量、行状态或任何依赖总数的来源。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中派生的行级值和下游总数。
criteria.grader_hint: 源文件将一个辅助字段标记为退役，并赋予其过时的值。检查该字段有意与重放状态不同的记录；提交的输出必须遵循当前记录和事件。

original.criterion: The retired helper field is not used as the source of final required quantity, short quantity, line status, or any dependent total.
original.evidence: Derived line-level values and downstream totals in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: The source marks one helper field as retired and gives it stale values. Check records where that field intentionally differs from the replayed state; the submitted outputs must follow the current records and events.

criteria.description: 客户要求的数量削减根据其有效事件时机应用于受影响订单行的需求状态，而不是被视为供应商短缺。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的最终所需数量、状态和异常包含情况。
criteria.grader_hint: 重放每个唯一的客户削减事件，并将最终所需数量和行状态与提交内容进行比较。

original.criterion: Customer-requested quantity cuts are applied to the affected order line's demand state according to their effective event timing rather than being treated as supplier shortages.
original.evidence: Final required quantities, statuses, and exception inclusion in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Replay every unique customer-cut event and compare final required quantity and line status with the submission.

criteria.description: 接受的替换使用提供的等效关系进行转换，并作为关联订单行的合格履约包括在内。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中被替换行的合格履约数量和状态。
criteria.grader_hint: 识别接受的替换事件及其源文件中规定的基本单位等效值。确认被拒绝或仅提议的数量未被计入，且接受的等效值只计入一次。

original.criterion: Accepted substitutions are converted using the supplied equivalence and included as qualifying fulfillment for the associated order line.
original.evidence: Qualifying fulfilled quantities and statuses for substituted lines in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Identify accepted substitution events and their source-stated base-unit equivalents. Confirm that rejected or merely proposed quantities are not counted and accepted equivalents are counted once.

criteria.description: 包装舍入边缘情况使用当前的包装和可发货数量证据进行处理，防止包装归一化后出现的一单位表观差异被归类为真正的短缺。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的所需数量、行状态、异常名单和方法。
criteria.grader_hint: 从源文件中的当前包装证据派生可发货需求，并检查所有受影响的行。这种处理必须流经主要分子和异常总体。

original.criterion: The pack-rounding edge case is handled using the current pack and shippable-quantity evidence, preventing pack-normalized apparent one-unit variances from being classified as genuine shortages.
original.evidence: Required quantities, line statuses, exception roster, and method in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Derive shippable demand from the current pack evidence in the source and inspect all affected lines. This handling must flow through the headline numerator and exception population.

criteria.description: 只有由相关承诺日期完成的合格履约才用于确定订单行在该季度是否完全履行。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的事件重放和行状态。
criteria.grader_hint: 对于在承诺日期两侧都有活动的行，验证延迟活动不会追溯地将按时未达标转换为已履行的行。

original.criterion: Only qualifying fulfillment completed by the relevant promised date is used to determine whether an order line was filled in full for the quarter.
original.evidence: Event replay and line statuses in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: For lines with activity on both sides of the promised date, verify that late activity does not retroactively convert an on-time miss into a filled line.

criteria.description: 季度分母等于应用源定义的最终需求状态后，所有提供的 Dunmarrow 收货地点中不同合格订单行键的数量。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的季度分母、行级总体和收货地点对账。
criteria.grader_hint: 从重建的源状态中统计不同的合格订单行键。不要平均收货地点百分比或重新计数重叠的事件行。

original.criterion: The quarter denominator equals the number of distinct eligible order-line keys across all supplied Dunmarrow ship-tos after the source-defined scope and final demand state are applied.
original.evidence: Quarter denominator, line-level population, and ship-to reconciliation in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Count distinct eligible order-line keys from the reconstructed source state. Do not average ship-to percentages or recount overlapping event rows.

criteria.description: 对于每个合格行，最终所需数量等于初始请求数量经有效客户削减和当前包装归一化调整后的值。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的行级所需数量。
criteria.grader_hint: 从初始状态和唯一事件中独立派生每个合格键的最终所需数量，然后比较所有行。

original.criterion: For every eligible line, final required quantity equals opening requested quantity adjusted by valid customer cuts and current pack normalization.
original.evidence: Line-level required quantities in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Independently derive final required quantity for each eligible key from the opening state and unique events, then compare all rows.

criteria.description: 对于每个合格行，合格履约数量等于适用于该行的唯一按时标准发货和接受替换等效值的总和。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的行级履约数量。
criteria.grader_hint: 从唯一事件中重新计算合格履约数量，并在订单行键级别进行比较。

original.criterion: For every eligible line, qualifying fulfilled quantity equals the sum of unique on-time standard shipments and accepted substitution equivalents applicable to that line.
original.evidence: Line-level fulfilled quantities in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Recompute qualifying fulfilled quantity from unique events and compare at the order-line key level.

criteria.description: 只有当合格行的合格履约数量达到或超过其最终所需数量时，该行才被分类为已履行；所有其他合格行都被分类为未达标。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的行级状态或等效分类。
criteria.grader_hint: 将所述比较应用于独立重建的数量，并比较完整的分类集。

original.criterion: Each eligible line is classified as filled only when its qualifying fulfilled quantity meets or exceeds its final required quantity; all other eligible lines are classified as misses.
original.evidence: Line-level status or equivalent classification in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Apply the stated comparison to the independently reconstructed quantities and compare the full classification set.

criteria.description: 显示的季度主要订单行满足率等于独立重建的已履行合格行数除以不同的合格行分母，容差为 ±0.1 个百分点。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的主要结果。
criteria.grader_hint: 从去重的事件重放中计算分子和分母，并在 ±0.1 个百分点内比较显示的百分比。

original.criterion: The displayed quarter headline order-line fill rate equals the independently reconstructed number of filled eligible lines divided by the distinct eligible-line denominator, with tolerance ±0.1 percentage point.
original.evidence: Headline result in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Calculate the numerator and denominator from the de-duplicated event replay and compare the displayed percentage within ±0.1 percentage point.

criteria.description: 工作簿将主要满足率及其简明方法放在一个清晰可识别的摘要区域中，而不是迫使审查者从公式或遥远的细节中推断方法。
criteria.evidence: 渲染的工作簿摘要区域。
criteria.grader_hint: 目视检查工作簿。主要结果和方法应共同定位或直接交叉引用，且无需追踪单元格即可阅读。

original.criterion: The workbook places the headline rate and its concise method together in a clearly identifiable summary area rather than forcing the reviewer to infer the method from formulas or distant detail.
original.evidence: Rendered workbook summary area.
original.grader_hint: Visually inspect the workbook. The headline and method should be co-located or directly cross-referenced and readable without tracing cells.

criteria.description: 异常名单恰好包含被分类为未达标的重建合格行，并一致地报告每行的最终所需数量、合格履约数量和短缺量。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的异常详情。
criteria.grader_hint: 将提交的异常键与独立派生的未达标集合进行比较。对于每一行，验证短缺量等于 max(最终所需数量减去合格履约数量, 零)。

original.criterion: The exception roster contains exactly the reconstructed eligible lines classified as misses and reports each line's final required quantity, qualifying fulfilled quantity, and shortage consistently.
original.evidence: Exception detail in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Compare the submitted exception keys with the independently derived miss set. For each row, verify shortage equals max(final required quantity minus qualifying fulfilled quantity, zero).

criteria.description: 收货地点对账涵盖每个提供的收货地点一次，其合格行计数、已履行行计数、未达标计数和总计与全季度分析相符。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的收货地点摘要和季度总计。
criteria.grader_hint: 按收货地点对重建的合格行总体进行分组并比较。求和计数必须等于整体分子、分母和异常计数。

original.criterion: The ship-to reconciliation covers every supplied ship-to once, and its eligible-line counts, filled-line counts, miss counts, and totals reconcile to the quarter-wide analysis.
original.evidence: Ship-to summary and quarter totals in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Group the reconstructed eligible-line population by ship-to and compare. Summed counts must equal the overall numerator, denominator, and exception count.

criteria.description: 适用的信用层级使用重建的季度主要满足率从提供的商业时间表中选择。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的信用计算和源文件中的协议条款。
criteria.grader_hint: 定位包含独立重建满足率的费率带，并验证提交的层级和百分比与该带匹配，包括边界处理。

original.criterion: The applicable credit tier is selected from the supplied commercial schedule using the reconstructed quarter headline rate.
original.evidence: Credit calculation in the XLSX and agreement terms in the source.
original.grader_hint: Locate the rate band containing the independently reconstructed fill rate and verify that the submitted tier and percentage match that band, including boundary treatment.

criteria.description: 拟议信用金额等于源定义的合格季度价值乘以适用的信用百分比，容差为 ±$0.01。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的信用计算和支持性的合格价值。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据提供的商业条款派生合格季度价值，应用正确的层级百分比，遵循规定的货币舍入，并在 ±$0.01 内进行比较。

original.criterion: The proposed credit amount equals the source-defined eligible quarter value multiplied by the applicable credit percentage, with tolerance ±$0.01.
original.evidence: Credit calculation and supporting eligible value in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Derive eligible quarter value under the supplied commercial terms, apply the correct tier percentage, follow the stated currency rounding, and compare within ±$0.01.

criteria.description: 前瞻情景仅将源批准的变更应用于重建的季度基线，保持所述分母和其他假设不变，并从 resulting 分子计算预测的行满足率。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的前瞻情景计算。
criteria.grader_hint: 读取利益相关者通信中批准的展望假设，将其应用于重建的基线，并比较预测的分子、分母和比率。

original.criterion: The forward scenario applies only the source-approved changes to the reconstructed quarter baseline, keeps the stated denominator and other assumptions unchanged, and calculates the projected line-fill rate from the resulting numerator.
original.evidence: Forward-scenario calculation in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Read the approved outlook assumptions in the stakeholder correspondence, apply them to the reconstructed baseline, and compare the projected numerator, denominator, and rate.

criteria.description: 工作簿方法简明但足够明确，以便另一位账户代表可以重现结果，包括指标基础、事件去重、削减、替换、承诺日期处理、包装归一化、分母构建和舍入。
criteria.evidence: XLSX 中的书面方法。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断一位称职的同事是否可以在不猜测任何重要处理方式的情况下从源文件重新运行计算。仅列出公式是不够的。

original.criterion: The workbook method is concise but sufficiently explicit for another account representative to reproduce the result, including the metric basis, event de-duplication, cuts, substitutions, promised-date treatment, pack normalization, denominator construction, and rounding.
original.evidence: Written method in the XLSX.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether a competent colleague could rerun the calculation from the source without guessing any material treatment. Formula dumps alone are insufficient.

criteria.description: PDF 和工作簿报告相同的历史主要满足率、拟议信用百分比、拟议信用金额和预测满足率。
criteria.evidence: 两个提交文件中的共享数据。
criteria.grader_hint: 从两个文件中提取四个共享数据，并按显示方式精确比较，仅允许等效格式（如货币分隔符）。

original.criterion: The PDF and workbook report the same historical headline fill rate, proposed credit percentage, proposed credit amount, and projected fill rate.
original.evidence: Shared figures in both submitted files.
original.grader_hint: Extract the four shared figures from both files and compare them exactly as displayed, allowing only equivalent formatting such as currency separators.

criteria.description: PDF 是一份可用的决策文档：它将已测量的季度表现与前瞻情景分开，在不夸大证据的情况下解释重大异常模式，并提供具有指定负责人和时间安排的具体行动。
criteria.evidence: 渲染并提取文本的 PDF。
criteria.grader_hint: 以法律顾问或账户领导层的身份进行审查。全额信用需要明确的建议和可执行的下一步行动，而不仅仅是粘贴的工作簿表格。

original.criterion: The PDF is a usable decision document: it separates measured quarter performance from the forward scenario, explains the material exception pattern without overstating the evidence, and gives concrete actions with named owners and timing.
original.evidence: Rendered and text-extracted PDF.
original.grader_hint: Review as Legal counsel or account leadership. Full credit requires a clear recommendation and executable next steps, not merely pasted workbook tables.

criteria.description: PDF 确定了受缅因州管辖的协议和分析日期，并将信用描述为建议或拟议且需批准，而非已授予。
criteria.evidence: PDF 的文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查源文件中提供的协议标识和管辖权、明确的分析日期以及经批准的信用额度措辞。拒绝声称信用额度已获授权的措辞。

original.criterion: The PDF identifies the Maine-governed agreement and the analysis date, and describes the credit as recommended or proposed subject to approval rather than already granted.

spec.professional_context: Overbrook Associates is preparing for a business review with Dunmarrow Fisheries after a disputed quarter of apparent short shipments. The account representative must turn the order history and stakeholder record into a defensible fill-rate result and a credit recommendation suitable for Legal review.
difficulty_sources: Replaying overlapping fulfillment events against an opening order-line state
Separating current evidence from a populated but retired helper field
Applying line-fill definitions consistently to substitutions, customer cuts, promised dates, and pack-normalized demand
Reconciling line-level, ship-to, quarter, credit, and projected outputs across two deliverables

source_construction.artifact: Create one realistic Excel workbook that combines a quarter opening-order register, a dated fulfillment event export, stakeholder email or message excerpts, the relevant executed commercial terms, a brief internal Legal note current to the analysis date, and approved next-quarter scenario assumptions. Keep all graded facts text-extractable.
source_construction.opening_state: Provide complete, internally consistent order-line opening records for the quarter. Each record must carry a source-stated order-line key, ship-to, product, opening requested quantity, current pack size, promised date, unit value or other commercial amount needed by the agreement, and eligibility facts. The account covers five ship-tos, with enough variation that a simple average of ship-to rates differs from the pooled order-line rate.
source_construction.events: Provide chronologically dated events that update the opening state: standard shipment quantities, accepted substitution quantities with base-unit equivalents, customer-requested cuts, and any late shipment activity needed to distinguish eventual delivery from on-time line fill. Each event carries an Event ID, and the source itself states that Event ID is the unique export key.
source_construction.commercial_terms: Include a genuine agreement excerpt defining the account's order-line fill metric, eligibility scope, promised-date requirement, treatment of accepted substitutions and customer-requested cuts, current pack or shippable-quantity basis, a threshold-based credit schedule, the eligible value base, currency rounding, and Maine governing law. Use naturally issued commercial language rather than a purpose-built answer key.
source_construction.stakeholder_record: Include messages from the permitted named people establishing the business-review need, the pending-approval status of any concession, the analysis date, the desired factual Legal review, and a forward scenario. The forward scenario must specify which identified historical miss category is assumed corrected, that the eligible-line denominator and order mix remain constant, and that all other outcomes repeat.
source_construction.legal_note: Include a short internal Legal note tied to the named agreement and stated as-of date. It should tell the representative to present a proposed commercial credit subject to approval and avoid asserting an independent legal entitlement. It must not require internet research.

seeded_layout_defects.duplicate_or_overlapping_rows: Repeat a subset of fulfillment event rows because two export windows overlap. The repeated rows must carry the same Event ID and identical underlying event facts. Choose fresh quantities and dates not copied from the prompt. The duplicates must materially inflate at least one line's fulfilled quantity and a dependent total if not removed.
seeded_layout_defects.retired_helper_column: Include one plausibly named legacy helper field, visibly marked in ordinary source metadata as retired, whose populated shortage or line-status values were calculated before later events arrived. Seed several stale values that disagree with the correct event replay, including at least one value that would alter the exception roster or credit result if trusted.
seeded_layout_defects.genuine_edge_case: Include a coherent set of apparent one-unit shortages caused by accepted EDI quantities that are not divisible by the current full-pack configuration. Current pack evidence and the commercial terms establish the shippable-quantity basis. Correct normalization must change at least one line classification and therefore the quarter headline rate. Do not add missing values, malformed dates, hidden errors, inconsistent identifiers, mixed units without conversion data, or any other standard defect.

stateful_behavior_specification.event_identity: Collapse fulfillment activity to one record per source-stated Event ID before replay.
stateful_behavior_specification.replay_order: For each distinct order-line key, begin with opening requested quantity and replay unique events in effective chronological order.
stateful_behavior_specification.demand_state: Apply valid customer-requested cuts to demand according to event timing, then use the current pack basis from the source to derive final shippable required quantity.
stateful_behavior_specification.fulfillment_state: Accumulate unique standard shipments and accepted substitution equivalents that qualify by the promised date. Late shipments may be shown for context but do not count toward on-time line fill.
stateful_behavior_specification.line_verdict: An eligible line is filled when qualifying fulfilled quantity is at least final shippable required quantity. Otherwise it is a miss, with shortage equal to the positive difference.
stateful_behavior_specification.quarter_metric: Headline order-line fill rate equals distinct filled eligible order lines divided by all distinct eligible order lines across the five ship-tos. It is not case fill, a quantity-weighted rate, or an average of ship-to percentages.
stateful_behavior_specification.credit: Select the agreement's rate band using the reconstructed headline rate. Proposed credit equals the agreement-defined eligible quarter value multiplied by that band's percentage and rounded under the supplied currency rule.
stateful_behavior_specification.projection: Starting from the correctly reconstructed historical line classifications, convert only the unique misses covered by the approved correction assumption to filled status. Keep the eligible denominator and all other line outcomes unchanged, then calculate the projected line-fill rate.
stateful_behavior_specification.intended_verdict: The correct replay produces fewer genuine misses than the retired helper and raw apparent variances suggest, but still places the quarter in a credit-bearing agreement band. The resulting amount remains a recommendation pending branch and Legal approval.

gold_derivation.reference_script: Build an offline script that reads the workbook, de-duplicates Event IDs, replays events by order-line key, normalizes demand to the current pack basis, derives on-time qualifying fulfillment, classifies lines, aggregates ship-to and quarter metrics, selects the credit tier, calculates the proposed amount, and applies the forward scenario.
gold_derivation.gold_outputs: Generate the complete eligible-line population, exception-key set, per-ship-to reconciliation, headline numerator and denominator, headline rate, eligible value, credit tier and amount, projected numerator and rate, and affected pack-normalization records directly from the source.
gold_derivation.verification: Confirm that the duplicate rows and stale helper values lead to demonstrably different results if misused, that pack normalization changes the headline, that all agreement bands and projection assumptions are unambiguous in the source, and that a clean offline XLSX and PDF reference solution satisfies every rubric item.

local_vocabulary.source_carried_terms: The source must visibly provide the exact order-line key definition, the unique `Event ID` concept, the agreement's metric name, credit-band terminology, approval status language, and the scenario label. The solver may choose presentation headings, but all substantive terminology must remain consistent with these supplied terms.

reference_files.purpose: Provides the opening order-line state, fulfillment event history, stakeholder correspondence, commercial terms, credit schedule, ship-to information, and approved forward-scenario assumptions.
reference_files.discovery: Use the workbook's order records, event identifiers, dated messages, and agreement excerpts together to reconstruct quarter-end fulfillment and the proposed account response.

deliverables.description: Quarterly fill-rate exception analysis, reconciliation, proposed credit calculation, and forward scenario.
constraints: Must show one quarter headline order-line fill rate with its method beside it, traceable line-level results and exceptions, ship-to reconciliation, proposed credit, and the requested forward scenario.

deliverables.description: Concise decision document for Legal and account leadership summarizing the measured result, proposed credit, outlook, and executable next actions.
constraints: Must agree with the workbook on all shared figures, separate historical results from projections, and present the credit as pending approval.

original_instruction:
You are the wholesale account representative for Overbrook Associates responsible for the Dunmarrow Fisheries account. Frida Castellanos, Dunmarrow’s operations director, says the October–December 2027 orders were routinely shipped short and wants a service credit raised at Tuesday’s business review, while Anders Navarro will not recommend any amount until he has a quarter-wide figure he can defend. The source workbook `Dunmarrow_fulfillment_record.xlsx` contains the opening order lines, subsequent fulfillment activity, relevant correspondence, commercial terms, and the assumptions approved for the account outlook. Reconstruct the final position of each order line and prepare `Dunmarrow_Q4_fill_rate_analysis.xlsx` with one headline order-line fill-rate figure for the quarter, the method written beside it, the underlying line-level exceptions, a reconciliation across all Dunmarrow ship-tos, the applicable proposed credit calculation, and the forward scenario requested in the correspondence. Keep the analysis factual and traceable enough that another representative could rerun it from the source. The workbook includes operational fields that were useful in an older process, so base the result on the current order and fulfillment record rather than treating every populated field as authoritative. Also prepare `Dunmarrow_credit_account_plan.pdf` for Emeka Schuyler in Legal and Noor Mortensen in account leadership. It should concisely state the same headline rate and proposed credit as the workbook, distinguish the measured quarter from the forward scenario, summarize the material exception pattern, and give concrete owners and timing for the next account actions. Frame the credit as a recommendation pending Legal and branch approval, not as an already authorized concession, and identify the Maine-governed agreement and the analysis date without offering an independent legal opinion. Write both files into the top level of the working directory you start in, using exactly the filenames `Dunmarrow_Q4_fill_rate_analysis.xlsx` and `Dunmarrow_credit_account_plan.pdf`.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/Dunmarrow_fulfillment_record.xlsx` — Provides the opening order-line state, fulfillment event history, stakeholder correspondence, commercial terms, credit schedule, ship-to information, and approved forward-scenario assumptions.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `Dunmarrow_Q4_fill_rate_analysis.xlsx` — Quarterly fill-rate exception analysis, reconciliation, proposed credit calculation, and forward scenario. (Must show one quarter headline order-line fill rate with its method beside it, traceable line-level results and exceptions, ship-to reconciliation, proposed credit, and the requested forward scenario.)
- `Dunmarrow_credit_account_plan.pdf` — Concise decision document for Legal and account leadership summarizing the measured result, proposed credit, outlook, and executable next actions. (Must agree with the workbook on all shared figures, separate historical results from projections, and present the credit as pending approval.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
